name: The Fenside Lamp
description: The drowned crofts and the First Lamp on the Amberfen's waist. The crofters' rows stand under water with the scarecrow in to its waist, the corn is cut green onto stilted pallets, the old sluice hangs on two posts at the reach with a kelp-string on the near one, and Hale's lamp burns at the hamlet gate.

signs.title: THE OLD SLUICE
lines: two posts and a broken gate
somebody tied kelp to the near post

signs.title: DROWNED CORN
lines: cut green and stacked on the pallets

signs.title: THE FIRST LAMP
lines: a Waykeeper lamp. lit at dusk
